'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|War in Sudan (2023)]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***A [[United States|U.S.]] embassy convoy is attacked in [[Khartoum]], amid U.S. efforts to mediate a [[ceasefire]]. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-fighting-military-us-convoy-attacked-60b1568b3bd05cdf6ad78c7f17cc8208 (AP)]
***[[India]] tells its citizens to find shelter or stay indoors. [https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/international/2421325-indian-embassy-in-sudan-issues-precautionary-advisory-for-indian-nationals-against-venturing-out-suggest-rationing-supplies (Dev Discourse)]
***[[Canada]] closes its embassy in [[Sudan]] and advises its citizens against travelling to the country. [https://globalnews.ca/news/9630315/sudan-violence-unrest-canada/ (Global News)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Russian annexation of Donetsk, Kherson, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia oblasts]]
***[[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] makes a rare visit to [[Russia]]n-occupied [[Kherson Oblast|Kherson]] and [[Luhansk Oblast|Luhansk]] oblasts and meets with [[Russian Armed Forces|military]] commanders in charge of military operations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/putin-visits-two-regions-ukraine-g7-condemn-nuclear-plan-2023-04-18/ (Reuters)]
**Former [[People's Deputy of Ukraine]] [[Oleh Barna]] is killed in combat. [https://www.unian.net/war/na-fronte-pogib-eks-nardep-oleg-barna-12224391.html (UNIAN)]
*Six [[Fula people|Fulani]] [[herder]]s are killed by Kodo armed men during an attack on two villages in [[Logone Oriental (region)|Logone Oriental]], [[Chad]]. Fourteen attackers are killed by soldiers in the ensuing gunfight, while two others are killed in the initial clashes with the Fulanis. [https://www.barrons.com/news/chad-clashes-between-herders-farmers-kill-22-45feb927 (''Barron's'')]

'''Business and economy''' 
*[[Netflix]] ends its [[DVD]] rental service after 25 years, citing the reduced demand for physical rentals. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-65318695 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Beijing hospital fire]]
**Twenty-nine people are killed in a fire at a hospital in [[Beijing]], [[China]]. [https://english.news.cn/20230418/74a67dbc9a3c41c09730a624d99528b3/c.html (Xinhua)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/18/fire-in-beijing-hospital-kills-21-state-media (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2023 Torkham landslide]]
**Two people are killed and dozens of others are feared missing after a [[landslide]] occurs in the [[Khyber Pass]] in [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/landslide-pakistans-khyber-pass-buries-trucks-dozens-feared-trapped-2023-04-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 New York City parking garage collapse]]
**One person is killed and five others are injured by the partial collapse of a [[parking garage]] in [[Manhattan]], [[New York City]], [[United States]]. Nearby buildings of [[Pace University]] are [[emergency evacuation|evacuated]] due to the instability of the garage's remaining structure. [https://www.cbsnews.com/newyork/news/lower-manhattan-parking-garage-collapse/ (WCBS-TV)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Brazil–Ukraine relations]]
**The [[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian government]] invites [[President of Brazil|Brazilian President]] [[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] to visit [[Ukraine]] and criticizes Lula for his approach to the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|conflict]]. [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Minister]] [[Sergei Lavrov]] welcomes Lula's position on peace efforts. [https://www.reuters.com/world/ukraine-invites-brazils-lula-visit-criticizes-his-peace-efforts-2023-04-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexico–United States relations]]
**[[President of Mexico|Mexican President]] [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] accuses the [[United States Department of Defense]] of spying and says that he will classify information from the [[Mexican Armed Forces]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexican-president-accuses-pentagon-spying-vows-restrict-military-information-2023-04-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[Palestine–Saudi Arabia relations]]
**[[President of Palestine|Palestinian President]] [[Mahmoud Abbas]] and [[Hamas]] [[Chairman of the Hamas Political Bureau|chairman]] [[Ismail Haniyeh]] meet in [[Riyadh]], [[Saudi Arabia]], to discuss the increase in violence in the [[West Bank]], the detainment of Hamas-affiliated [[Palestinians]] in Saudi Arabia, and about improving relations between Hamas and Saudi Arabia. This is the first meeting between Hamas and the [[House of Saud|Saudi royal family]] since 2015. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/4/18/abbas-arrives-in-saudi-arabia-coinciding-with-hamas-visit (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Accession of Kosovo to the European Union]]
**The [[European Parliament]] votes to grant [[Visa policy of the Schengen Area|visa-free travel]] for [[Kosovo]] citizens to any country that is part of the [[Schengen Area]]. The policy will be in effect no later than January 2024. [https://www.rferl.org/a/eu-lawmakers-approve-visa-free-travel-kosovo-/32369241.html (RFE/RL)]

*At least four people are severely injured in a stabbing attack at a gym in [[Duisburg]], [[Germany]]. [https://www.standard.co.uk/news/world/gym-attack-germany-duisburg-casualties-b1075007.html (''Evening Standard'')]
